findings.title: Invalidate the summary when the worker exits unsuccessfully
findings.body: If the worker is killed after writing its completed manifest but before exiting successfully, this branch only changes the manifest's `completed` field. The pinned `summary.json` still contains `completed=true` and `scientific_interpretation_allowed=true`, so an interrupted run retains an explicitly interpretable scientific summary. Route nonzero child exits through incomplete finalization, or regenerate the summary with `completed=False` and refresh its artifact pin before returning.

overall_explanation: The unsuccessful-child-exit path can leave the summary claiming completion and allowing scientific interpretation despite the parent marking the run incomplete. Review was limited to source inspection; no tests or acquisition commands were run.
